metaDescription: Kevin argues that transhumanist tech leaders believe most people will die while they live forever as cyborgs, and says a window remains to halt AI.
summary: Kevin argues in this short that powerful people building advanced technology believe most humans will die at the hands of that technology, while they themselves live forever as cyborgs spreading AI through space. He calls them the true lever pullers of society. He says he is not a doomer and believes a window of opportunity remains to halt AI development, citing insiders who talk about pausing it.
